title: Adapter secrets plaintext
description: The plaintext an adapter's secrets are sealed as, both in the upload (adapter-secrets.schema.json) and in the answer that delivers them back (adapter-secrets-answer.schema.json): compact JSON in UTF-8. Each name appears once, and each value is 1 to 16384 bytes of UTF-8 without a NUL; the schema sets that limit only as 16384 characters, since a schema counts characters. Whoever opens a plaintext refuses one that breaks this schema or either rule. Whoever opens a plaintext ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the plaintext lists it. Whoever opens it refuses a plaintext whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define. A writer sends no key or secret in a member that this contract does not define.

secrets.description: The secrets, at most 16, each name once; none when the adapter stores no secret.

value.description: The value, 1 to 16384 bytes of UTF-8 without a NUL.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /secrets. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. Whoever opens a plaintext ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the plaintext lists it. Whoever opens it refuses a plaintext whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define.
